record.title: Capture the first stock mapped access with an external native supervisor
record.intent: Test a callback-free transport at the existing mapped-access boundary.
requirements: Preserve stock APK, library and executable instructions; never complete an unknown hardware access.
Restrict syscall argument changes to the observed main-thread mapping tuple on the selected bypass descriptor.
Keep guest SELinux enforcing and do not alter host policy or access instruments.
acceptance: Pin compiler, native helper and Linux ABI reference inputs; document the narrow native-tooling exception.
Validate syscall entry/exit and protected-memory fault capture with deterministic private 32/64-bit read/write controls.
Capture stock original mapping arguments, substituted protection, kernel return, first signal, registers and opcode or explicit negative.
Preserve full evidence, stock hashes and system_server stability through bounded teardown.
